name: autospine
description: AI-assisted 2D rigging and animation automation engine

scripts.parse:png: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js parse-png
scripts.parse:psd: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js parse-psd
scripts.mesh:png: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js mesh-png
scripts.mesh:asset: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js mesh-asset
scripts.rig:chain: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js rig-chain
scripts.build:job: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js build
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
